terms.gloss: excessive fear of the gods, unreasonable religious belief, superstition
evidence: Cic. ND 2.71: majōrēs nostrī superstitiōnem ā religiōne sēparāvērunt (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Div. 2.148: nec vērō superstitiōne tollendā religiō tollitur (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: majōrēs nostrī superstitiōnem ā religiōne sēparāvērunt
phrases.english: our ancestors distinguished superstition from religion

phrases.latin: nec vērō superstitiōne tollendā religiō tollitur
phrases.english: nor, indeed, is religion done away with by doing away with superstition
